text:
maria-support: Customer on acct acme-corp hitting embeddings endpoint with spikes in tail latency and intermittent auth/billing errors. p95 jumped from ~120ms -> ~2.3s after a config change yesterday. Seeing 400 DimensionMismatch + 402 billing_overage in the same window. req_id=f8a3c2, trace=tr-1187. Anyone seen this combo after dynbatch tuning? :frowning:

sam-ml: When exactly did the config change go out? any rollout notes?

maria-support: rolled max_batch_size 32->128 at 2026-03-16T18:10Z (prod). Quick logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-16T18:12:03Z] ERROR embed_service request_id=f8a3c2 status=400 err=DimensionMismatch expected=1536 got=1
[2026-03-16T18:12:03Z] WARN auth service: token_refresh failed for key=k-xxxx status=402 billing_overage
[2026-03-16T18:12:04Z] INFO dynbatch controller: coalesced=98 flush_ms=1200 p95=2300
```

kai-infra: I can confirm a dynbatch.tail_latency_p95 spike at that time. coalesce_window_ms still set to 30ms, and with max_batch_size=128 small single-item requests are accumulating into long flushes. What's the model and typical payload size?

maria-support: model=embed-large-1536. Most client requests are tiny (avg tokens ~6) — also found a few clients accidentally sending precomputed vectors which triggered DimensionMismatch. Example bad curl we captured:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\ 
 -H \"Authorization: Bearer <key>\" \\ 
 -d '{"model":"embed-large-1536","input":[[0.1,0.2,...]]}'
```

jess-platform: two items: 1) the 402 billing_overage explains the intermittent auth-like failures; finance can triage credits if our config change caused higher billable units. 2) For the latency, recommended immediate mitigations: roll max_batch_size back to 32, reduce coalesce_window_ms to 10ms, or temporarily disable dynamic batching for the affected tenant. Also enable strict_dim_check on the route so clients sending precomputed vectors get clear 400s instead of noisy downstream failures.

maria-support: repro script (simple load loop) that reproduces the tail spike + occasional 402: 
```
import requests
for _ in range(600):
  requests.post(url, json={"model":"embed-large-1536","input":"short text"})
```
I'll run this against a staging tenant and capture traces.

sam-ml: quick workaround to test: rollback max_batch_size and set pad_to_max=false so tiny requests aren't inflated; if p95 drops that's a strong signal dynbatch coalescing was the driver. Also try smaller coalesce window and lower max_inflight.

kai-infra: I'll run a canary turning dynbatch off for dev-42 and post metrics in ~15m.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: tenant=dev-42 dynbatch=off at 2026-03-17T02:05:10Z

maria-support: thanks — I'll monitor the customer, collect traces from the flagged req_ids, and follow up with the customer. tagging @jess-platform for billing/escalation. :)
